datasets.description: Somalia Medium Term Projection FEWS NET Acute Food Insecurity Classifications Geographic data for 2021. [Source: This metadata record was automatically extracted from the Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX); Original dataset: https://data.humdata.org/dataset/somalia_medium_term_projection__fewsnet_ipc_shapefile_for_2021]
datasets.purpose: IPC Classification spatial data in different IPC scenarios collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a regular schedule (typically monthly).

lineage.description: FEWS NET enumerators collected IPC classification data monthly throughout 2021 across Somalia, classifying geographic areas into food insecurity phases. The data represents medium-term projections of acute food insecurity conditions aggregated at the sub-national level.

sources.name: FEWS NET
sources.description: Integrated Food Security Phase Classification (IPC) spatial data collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a monthly schedule to assess acute food insecurity severity across geographic areas.
